processing.colors: original video; gamma .78, gain 1.08; bounded unsharp .6 at sigma 1
processing.matting: registered alpha guides, dense optical flow, seeded GrabCut
processing.stabilization: fixed similarity calibrated to upright body size and standing baseline; preserve crouch and jump
processing.interpolation: bidirectional optical flow on premultiplied RGBA at original timestamps
processing.light_cleanup: cyan effects below skirt only, local adjacent pixel reconstruction

alpha_references.prompt: Background extraction for a video alpha-matte reference. Remove all scenery, ground, floating symbols, blue/purple glowing ribbons, sparkles and horizontal light streaks. Keep ONLY the entire visible Citlali character, including every hair tip, sleeping mask, all fingers, both arms, the complete skirt and its attached tails, both legs, both boots and their soles. Preserve EXACT original pose, position, proportions, canvas framing and pixel coordinates on the 736x864 canvas. Do not recenter, resize, redraw, sharpen, add, or invent any body parts. Preserve transparent holes between limbs and strands. The large floating purple symbol at the left is NOT part of her. The cyan star and light streaks are NOT part of her. Output a genuinely transparent PNG. This will be used ONLY as an alpha reference; animation colors will come from the original video.
alpha_references.use: Only registered alpha guidance; generated RGB never enters the animation.
